'''Luptoomians''' were [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Luptoom]]. The Luptoomians were known for wearing [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that was fashioned to resemble [[Plant/Legends|plants]].<ref name="CSWECite">{{CSWECite|II|267|Luptoomian}}</ref>
